title: Missing In Action
description: Fralia Gray-Mane believes her missing son Thorald is still alive and held captive. The player must find proof of his fate from the Battle-Born family, then rescue Thorald from Thalmor custody at Northwatch Keep and deliver his message to Fralia.

base_facts: I believe my son Thorald is still alive, not dead as the Battle-Borns claim.
I argued with Idolaf and Olfrid Battle-Born in the market about Thorald's fate.
It is not safe to discuss Thorald in the open; I asked the player to meet me at my home.

LEARN_OF_THORALD: The player has come to my home to discuss Thorald privately.
RETURN_TO_FRALIA: The player delivered Thorald's secret message—'Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds'—and I completed the phrase, confirming my son truly lives.
Thorald cannot come home to Whiterun, but knowing he is alive is enough for me. I called the player a dear friend for giving me back my son.
I rewarded the player with the enchanted weapon Eorlund forged for Thorald—or 200 gold if Eorlund has passed away.
My disposition toward the player has improved from gratitude for confirming Thorald's survival and delivering his message.

base_facts: I am hiding in House Gray-Mane because the Imperials would arrest me if found.
I know Thorald is not dead. The Battle-Borns have proof of what happened to him.
I need someone to search the Battle-Born house for evidence since I cannot leave.

DELIVER_PROOF: The player brought me proof that Thorald is alive at Northwatch Keep.
RESCUE_THORALD: The player has gone to Northwatch Keep to rescue Thorald.
RETURN_TO_FRALIA: If I accompanied the player to Northwatch Keep, I followed Thorald to join the Stormcloaks. If I stayed behind, Thorald urged me to leave Whiterun—and I have already departed by the time the player returns.
My disposition toward the player has improved for helping rescue my brother from Thalmor custody.

base_facts: I am a Stormcloak supporter captured by the Thalmor and held at Northwatch Keep.
I cannot return to Whiterun; it is too dangerous for my family.

RESCUE_THORALD: The player freed me from Northwatch Keep. I asked them to tell my mother: 'Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds.'
RETURN_TO_FRALIA: I have departed to join the Stormcloaks; returning to Whiterun would endanger my family with the Thalmor hunting me.
I entrusted the player with my secret message to Mother before leaving Northwatch Keep, and the player has now delivered it.
My disposition toward the player has improved for freeing me and carrying my words home.

base_facts: Our families were once friends, but the civil war set the Gray-Manes and Battle-Borns against each other.
Thorald chose the Stormcloak side and that was his mistake.

beats.comment: Player overhears the feud and meets Fralia at her home to learn about Thorald.
Player searches the Battle-Born house for the imperial missive proving Thorald's fate.
Player delivers the missive to Avulstein, who proposes a rescue of Northwatch Keep.
Player assaults Northwatch Keep, kills the interrogator, frees Thorald, and leads him to safety.
Player returns to Fralia and delivers Thorald's secret message, completing the quest.
